name: Camp Sentinel
description_short: A Christian summer camp in Center Tuftonboro, NH, running since 1949. It offers overnight camp for boys and girls ages 7-15, day camp for ages 5-15, a three-day Little Adventures camp for ages 5-8, a two-week camp for ages 10-15, and teen programs, with swimming, boating, archery and a ropes course, plus nightly worship and Bible study (Vespers).
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming and boating are daily activities. The Leaders program includes a canoe trip on Dan Hole Pond. The page does not describe swim tests or lifeguard details.
refund_policy_summary: A $100 nonrefundable deposit per program confirms a spot. Full payment is due April 1; no refunds after April 1, and a $100 fee applies to program transfers. No refunds for behavior issues. Cancellation requests go in writing to the camp office.

warnings: The page is themed for 2027 but gives no dates for any summer session. Check the Program Brochure or registration page.
The Winter Camp dates (Fri Jan 8 to Sun Jan 10) have no year on the page. Jan 8 falls on a Friday in 2027, so 2027 is assumed. Confirm before booking.
The camp runs both overnight and day programs. camp_type is set to sleepaway because overnight camp is the main program.
Overnight camp uses tiered pricing: families choose to pay $700, $750 or $800.
Age ranges cover only the youth and teen summer programs (5-16). Winter Camp is for ages 12-18, Adult Camp is for ages 55+, and Homeschool Family Camp is for whole families.
